SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS natural_customer_count FROM customers;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_city) AS city_count
FROM customers;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_category_name) AS category_cnt
FROM products;

SELECT order_id, order_item_id, freight_value
FROM order_items
WHERE freight_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY freight_value DESC, order_id ASC, order_item_id ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS review_with_title_count
FROM order_reviews
WHERE review_comment_title IS NOT NULL
  AND BTRIM(review_comment_title) <> '';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM members m
JOIN member_levels ml ON ml.level_id = m.level_id
WHERE ml.level_name = '黄金会员';

SELECT member_id, points
FROM members
WHERE points IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY points DESC, member_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT warehouse_id, capacity
FROM warehouses
WHERE capacity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY capacity DESC, warehouse_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS coupon_count
FROM coupons;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT keyword) FROM search_logs;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaigns WHERE status = 3;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) FROM product_price_history;
SELECT ROUND(SUM(price), 2) AS total_sales FROM order_items LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_product_price FROM order_items LIMIT 201

SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
GROUP BY order_status
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 100;
SELECT review_score, COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM order_reviews GROUP BY review_score ORDER BY review_score LIMIT 201

SELECT product_category_name, COUNT(*) AS product_cnt
FROM products
WHERE product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY product_category_name
ORDER BY product_cnt DESC, product_category_name ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT seller_state, COUNT(*) AS seller_count
FROM sellers
GROUP BY seller_state
ORDER BY seller_count DESC, seller_state ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100;

SELECT seller_id,
       ROUND(SUM(freight_value), 2) AS freight_revenue
FROM order_items
GROUP BY seller_id
ORDER BY freight_revenue DESC NULLS LAST, seller_id ASC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card') AS credit_card_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_type = 'boleto') AS boleto_count FROM order_payments LIMIT 201

SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM members
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status
LIMIT 10;

SELECT campaign_type, COUNT(*) AS campaign_count
FROM campaigns
GROUP BY campaign_type
ORDER BY campaign_type
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT reason_code, COUNT(*) AS refund_count
FROM refunds
GROUP BY reason_code
ORDER BY refund_count DESC
LIMIT 100;
SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM inventory;

SELECT movement_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM inventory_movements
GROUP BY movement_type
ORDER BY movement_type
LIMIT 100;

SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count
FROM shipments
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status
LIMIT 100;
SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS tickets FROM support_tickets GROUP BY category_id ORDER BY tickets DESC, category_id ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100;

SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS settlement_count
FROM settlements
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status
LIMIT 100;
SELECT ROUND(SUM(commission), 2) AS total_commission FROM settlements LIMIT 201

SELECT p.product_category_name
FROM products p
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1500
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, p.product_category_name ASC
LIMIT 100;
SELECT MAX(price) AS max_price, MIN(price) AS min_price FROM order_items;

SELECT y.year, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM (VALUES (2017), (2018)) AS y(year)
LEFT JOIN orders o
  ON EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int = y.year
GROUP BY y.year
ORDER BY y.year
LIMIT 2;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01 00:00:00'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-12-01 00:00:00';

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS order_month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS product_amount
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY order_month ASC
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS order_month,
       ROUND(AVG(oi.order_total), 2) AS avg_order_amount
FROM orders o
JOIN (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS order_total
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
) oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY order_month
LIMIT 100;

WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', MIN(order_purchase_timestamp))::date AS start_month,
         date_trunc('month', MAX(order_purchase_timestamp))::date AS end_month
  FROM orders
),
months AS (
  SELECT generate_series(start_month, end_month, interval '1 month')::date AS month
  FROM bounds
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS month,
         COUNT(order_id) AS order_cnt
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
),
joined AS (
  SELECT m.month,
         mc.order_cnt,
         LAG(mc.order_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY m.month) AS prev_cnt
  FROM months m
  LEFT JOIN monthly mc ON mc.month = m.month
)
SELECT month,
       CASE
         WHEN order_cnt IS NULL OR prev_cnt IS NULL OR prev_cnt = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE ROUND((order_cnt - prev_cnt)::numeric / prev_cnt, 4)
       END AS growth_rate
FROM joined
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= (SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp)::date - INTERVAL '89 days' FROM orders)
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < (SELECT MAX(order_purchase_timestamp)::date + INTERVAL '1 day' FROM orders);

SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS order_hour,
       COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
GROUP BY order_hour
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400)::numeric, 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM orders WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL LIMIT 201

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL), 0), 4) AS late_delivery_rate FROM orders LIMIT 201
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', requested_at) AS month, ROUND(SUM(refund_amount), 2) AS refund_amount FROM refunds GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 201
SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - created_at)) / 3600.0), 2) AS avg_resolution_hours FROM support_tickets WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL LIMIT 201

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', review_creation_date) AS month,
       ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_score
FROM order_reviews
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 100;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM members
WHERE last_login_date >= (SELECT MAX(last_login_date) FROM members) - 29
  AND last_login_date <= (SELECT MAX(last_login_date) FROM members);

SELECT c.customer_unique_id AS customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.customer_unique_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.customer_unique_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.product_category_name, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
ORDER BY order_count DESC, p.product_category_name ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
FROM order_items
GROUP BY seller_id
ORDER BY order_count DESC, seller_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM products p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM product_price_history h
  WHERE h.product_id = p.product_id
);

SELECT payment_type, ROUND(AVG(payment_value), 2) AS avg_payment_value
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY payment_type
LIMIT 100;

SELECT o.order_status, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_product_amount
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY o.order_status
LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_score
FROM order_reviews r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, c.customer_state ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT payment_type, ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.review_id, r.order_id, p.payment_type, r.review_score
  FROM order_reviews r
  JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = r.order_id
) t
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY payment_type
LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.macro_region, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS product_sales_excl_freight
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = c.customer_state
GROUP BY r.macro_region
ORDER BY product_sales_excl_freight DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT ca.campaign_id, COUNT(cu.usage_id) AS usage_count
FROM campaigns ca
JOIN coupons c ON c.campaign_id = ca.campaign_id
JOIN coupon_usages cu ON cu.coupon_id = c.coupon_id
GROUP BY ca.campaign_id
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT c.discount_type, ROUND(SUM(cu.discount_amount), 2) AS total_discount_amount
FROM coupons c
LEFT JOIN coupon_usages cu ON cu.coupon_id = c.coupon_id
GROUP BY c.discount_type
ORDER BY c.discount_type
LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.macro_region, SUM(w.capacity) AS total_capacity
FROM warehouses w
LEFT JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code
GROUP BY r.macro_region
LIMIT 100;
